sloka: स वाली गाढ संवीतो मुष्टिम् उद्यम्य वीर्यवान् ।सुग्रीवम् एव अभिमुखो ययौ योद्धुम् कृत क्षणः ॥४-१६-१७॥
transliteration: sa vālī gāḍha saṁvīto muṣṭim udyamya vīryavān ।sugrīvam eva abhimukho yayau yoddhum kṛta kṣaṇaḥ ॥4-16-17॥

translations.english: Vali tied up his cloth tightly, raised his fist and advanced towards Sugriva, ready for the encounter.
